component.name: Kilonova
component.summary: Monero wallet for full nodes and light wallet servers

description.p: Kilonova is an open-source Monero wallet. It scans the blockchain on your device from a Monero node you choose, or syncs through a light wallet server such as your own monero-lws.

ul.li: Several wallets, on mainnet, stagenet and testnet
Every output a light wallet server reports is checked with your own keys
Tor and SOCKS5 proxy for all traffic, onion nodes, pinned certificates
Address book, transaction notes and payment proofs
No accounts, no analytics, no server run by Dhiva Labs

description.p: Kilonova has not been audited yet. Do not keep more in it than you can afford to lose.
